usermeta.purpose: Visualizes total farm cash cost trajectories and compositional breakdown across agricultural sectors from 2000 to 2024.
usermeta.chartType: Streamgraph (Center-Stacked Area Chart with Monotone Interpolation)
usermeta.dataRequirements: Requires 'Year', 'Value' (Cash Costs), and 'Sector or industry' fields.

title.subtitle: Streamgraph showing total cash cost trajectory across agricultural sectors

data._comment: Loads 25-year cost composition CSV dataset containing sectoral cash cost values
